## Chisel 1.12.0 with PROXY v2 support

This is a custom build from [Skaronator/chisel](https://github.com/Skaronator/chisel),
based on the exact upstream [v1.12.0](https://github.com/jpillora/chisel/releases/tag/v1.12.0)
tag with reverse PROXY v2 forwarding added. It is not an official upstream release.

The feature was originally implemented by @lleyton in
[jpillora/chisel#552](https://github.com/jpillora/chisel/pull/552). The current
upstream submission is [jpillora/chisel#627](https://github.com/jpillora/chisel/pull/627).
This release keeps 1.12.0's existing dependency versions and adds
`github.com/pires/go-proxyproto v0.8.0`.

### PROXY v2 forwarding

Use `RP:` instead of `R:` to send original source address information to a
PROXY v2-aware backend:

```text
chisel server --reverse --port 8080
chisel client https://chisel.example.com RP:8443:127.0.0.1:443
```

The destination on port 443 must be configured to accept PROXY v2 headers
before its application traffic. TCP forwarding sends a header before the
stream; UDP forwarding (`RP:.../udp`) prepends one to each datagram.
Existing `R:` remotes are unchanged.

This does not add support for parsing incoming PROXY headers on the Chisel
server or using HTTP forwarding headers for logging. For UDP listeners bound
to a wildcard interface, the header uses the socket's local address rather
than the actual per-packet destination IP.

### Container image

```text
ghcr.io/skaronator/chisel:1.12.0-skn
```

Platforms: Linux amd64, arm64, ppc64le, 386, arm/v7, and arm/v6.
The images use a scratch base containing CA roots. Existing floating tags
(`latest`, `1`, and `1.12`) are not changed by this release.

### Downloads

Binary archives, Linux packages, and checksums are attached below. Release CI
checks every gzip and zip archive before publishing. The embedded version is
`1.12.0-skn`.

The `-skn` suffix identifies the custom build; GitHub lists it as a prerelease
to keep it separate from official upstream versions.

See the [upstream 1.12.0 release notes](https://github.com/jpillora/chisel/releases/tag/v1.12.0)
for the reliability, security, and upgrade changes included in this base version.
